summary: Administrators can no longer be locked out, and updates bring the database with them.

fixes.title: Administrators are recognised again
fixes.text: Valid administrators could be treated as read-only users. They, and delegated access profiles, are recognised correctly again.

fixes.title: Updates bring the database with them
fixes.text: Each update brings the database up to date first and never removes data. If the database cannot be updated, the update stops.

fixes.title: Protection against data loss
fixes.text: Replacing all records of one kind with nothing is refused, with a count of what would be removed. Deliberate clearing still works.

fixes.title: Every check offers a fix
fixes.text: Each check has a working fix or says what to do, and five gained one-click repairs. Wizard fields now suggest values.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Jobs that just ran are not shown as overdue, successful updates are not reported failed, and empty access reviews no longer send reminders.
